entries.title: Parallelize relay agent directory rebuild
entries.rationale: Accept as security-gated performance work. Preserve the shared per-rebuild concurrency ceiling across runtime-directory, owner-profile, and managed-policy phases; verify that exact-author filters, owner proof, policy selection, event sets, error handling, and send-path revalidation remain unchanged despite concurrency.
security_reasons: parallel queries feed the agent-selection and mention-authorization trust boundary
runtime directory, owner profile, and managed policy results must remain correctly correlated by pubkey
the concurrency bound must apply across all phases of one rebuild
relay query failures must not broaden the selected or authorized agent set
send-path revalidation must remain scoped and fail closed

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after authorization/data-correlation threat review, bounded-concurrency saturation tests, failure/revocation tests, exact event-set comparisons, dependency screening, and Zion branding/compatibility checks.

verification: Full-SHA query/concurrency diff, authorization data flow, semaphore scope, error behavior, changed tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; automated security-access report not claimed because its advisory was interrupted; no source implementation made.
